description.en: Gargantuar that destroys plants that look the same in one strike.
description.zh: 能一发摧毁所有相同植物的巨尸。

chat.en: This one's got a real temper on him. When he decides to take out a Plant...it's brutal. Just brutal.
chat.zh: 这家伙是真的非常暴脾气，只要他想解决掉一株植物……那场面，简直残暴，残暴至极。

text.zh: 用超新星权杖摧毁植物

text.en: destroys all the plants that are the same as those which have just been smashed
text.zh: 砸击植物时，同时摧毁所有相同的植物
